topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I found them on my doorstep this morning—stunning roses, a vibrant red, no card. Just there, as if they were an update to a story I’m desperately trying to follow but never quite can. Who would do this? It’s the waiting that gets to me, wondering if this is a silent message from someone close, or just a beautiful misunderstanding. I need to know. I keep replaying every interaction, every smile, every glance that might have hinted at something more, hoping for a clue. The petals are soft under my fingers, their scent a teasing mystery. I can’t just let this be a coincidence. It’s got to mean something, doesn’t it?
